in_marathi.name: Rajvir
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Kings
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajvir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Rajvir is derived from two Sanskrit words - Raja meaning King and Vir meaning Hero. The name Rajvir means 'King of Kings'. It is a powerful and courageous name, evoking the image of a brave ruler. The name is popular among Hindus and is often given to baby boys as a symbol of royalty and strength.
